world.title: Biggest El Nino in ‘over a century’ to dial up global heat, India braces for double crop hit
world.summary: A record-strength El Niño is anticipated to significantly increase global temperatures, potentially becoming the most powerful in over a century. Pacific waters may exceed normal temperatures by more than 3°C, impacting weather patterns worldwide. India is particularly vulnerable, facing challenges with monsoon conditions and agricultural output, which could lead to a double crop hit amid these climate changes.

world.title: Iran leaders sound economic alarms under Trump’s Economic D-Day
world.summary: Senior Iranian officials are expressing concerns about the economic impact of the ongoing conflict, coinciding with U.S. pressures under the Trump administration. The situation highlights the critical question of Iran's ability to sustain its military efforts financially. Additionally, the Houthis' unique position within Iran's regional network is noted, having established control over Sanaa since 2014.

world.title: Lindsay Clancy's defense rests after psychiatrist testimony in case of mother who killed children
world.summary: The defense in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial rested its case after several days of psychiatrist testimony regarding her mental state before and after the deaths of her three children. The trial, taking place in Plymouth, Massachusetts, has focused on Clancy's psychological condition. Following the defense's conclusion, prosecutors began presenting rebuttal witnesses to counter the defense's claims.

business.title: T.N. Government places orders with two jewellers for supply of gold rings scheme
business.summary: The Tamil Nadu Government has placed orders with Joyalukkas and Kalyan Jewellers to supply gold rings for a new scheme aimed at benefiting newborns. The work orders are distributed in a 70:30 ratio for one-gram gold rings under the “Thaimaman Thanga Mothiram Thittam” scheme, which is scheduled to launch on September 15.

business.title: Bitcoin nears $80,000 amid biggest weekly rally in three years
business.summary: Bitcoin has surged approximately 23% this week, approaching $80,000, marking its largest weekly gain since March 2023. The cryptocurrency last reached this price in May. Traders are evaluating the impact of rising bond yields and new market initiatives. If the current momentum continues, it could signify a significant shift in Bitcoin's market performance.

business.title: Sugar output may dip 11% from initial estimate: Government
business.summary: India's sugar production for the current season (October-September) is projected at 306 lakh tonnes, an 11% decrease from the initial estimate of 343 lakh tonnes. The government attributes rising sugar prices to lower output, increased festive demand, and crop damage, while ruling out ethanol diversion as a contributing factor. This decline may impact market dynamics and pricing.

technology.title: Trump to honour historic Artemis II crew
technology.summary: President Donald Trump will present the Congressional Space Medal of Honour to the four astronauts of NASA's Artemis II mission, which successfully orbited the Moon. This mission followed the uncrewed Artemis I test flight. The astronauts receiving the award are Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen. The announcement was made by NASA on Friday.

technology.title: 'Hoping for a Huge October Surprise, But Not Holding My Breath' - Arc Raiders Players Torn After Embark Delays Future Expeditions Until Early 2027
technology.summary: Embark Studios has postponed all future Arc Raiders Expeditions until early 2027 to implement significant improvements based on community feedback. The decision reflects the studio's commitment to enhancing the game experience. While players express disappointment over the delay, some acknowledge the necessity of the changes. The studio aims to deliver a more refined and engaging gameplay experience upon return.

technology.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Switch 2 60 fps performance impresses in first video
technology.summary: Early footage of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 on the Switch 2 shows the game running at 60 fps, impressing viewers ahead of its beta weekend. However, some textures and animations appear inferior compared to the PS5, Xbox, and PC versions. Nintendo fans have eagerly anticipated the franchise's return, with initial reactions highlighting the game's performance.

sports.title: GCT Finals with Pragg, So, Caruana and Keymer: Format and schedule
sports.summary: The 2026 Grand Chess Tour Finals will take place from August 22 to 27 at the Saint Louis Chess Club. The event features the top four players: Praggnanandhaa Rameshbabu, Wesley So, Fabiano Caruana, and Vincent Keymer, competing in a knockout format. The total prize fund for the tournament is $450,000, following the Sinquefield Cup.

sports.title: More than just a goal: Ronaldo ascends the historic throne of Al-Nassr in the Roshan League
sports.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo, captain of Al-Nassr, has become the club's all-time leading scorer in the Saudi Roshn League following his goal against Al-Riyadh. Al-Nassr secured a decisive 4-0 victory over Al-Riyadh at Prince Faisal bin Fahd Stadium. This achievement marks a significant milestone in Ronaldo's career, further solidifying his legacy within the club and the league.

sports.title: Arsenal deliver on Mikel Arteta's promise as defending champions flatten Coventry
sports.summary: Arsenal began their Premier League title defense with a decisive 3-0 victory over Coventry. Goals from Kai Havertz, Bukayo Saka, and Martin Odegaard secured the win, showcasing the team's strong performance. This match served as a clear statement to other teams in the league about Arsenal's intentions for the season ahead, emphasizing their readiness to defend the championship.

health.title: Coloured glassware belongs in every home
health.summary: Coloured glassware can enhance home decor by adding warmth, depth, and personality. Interior designers provide tips on integrating vibrant pieces into both minimalist and maximalist designs. The trend reflects a shift from minimalism to layered, personal spaces that showcase character. Homeowners are increasingly valuing unique decor elements that contribute to a more inviting and expressive atmosphere in their living environments.

health.title: 5-km Red Run mini marathon held to promote HIV/STI awareness
health.summary: A 5-km Red Run Mini Marathon was held in Deomali on August 21 to promote HIV and STI awareness. Organized by the Red Ribbon Club of Wangcha Rajkumar Govt College, in collaboration with local organizations, the event featured 50 runners. The Arunachal Pradesh State AIDS Control Society supported the initiative, emphasizing the theme “Youth for HIV & STI.”

health.title: CCMB uncovers link behind Titan cell formation in deadly fungus
health.summary: Scientists at the CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB) in Hyderabad have identified a biological circuit linking glucose metabolism, calcium signaling, and calcineurin to the formation of Titan cells in the fungus Cryptococcus neoformans. This discovery provides potential new targets for antifungal treatments, addressing a significant health threat posed by this dangerous pathogen.

science.title: Common Supplements Show Antibiotic-Like Benefits Against Severe Gum Disease
science.summary: A study indicates that combining two common supplements with standard treatments may provide antibiotic-like benefits for individuals with severe gum disease. This approach could potentially reduce reliance on antibiotics, which are often necessary for managing severe periodontitis. The findings suggest that integrating these supplements into treatment plans may enhance disease control and improve patient outcomes in dental health.

science.title: Astronomers uncover evidence of a galaxy merger 12 billion years ago that helped shape the young Milky Way
science.summary: Astronomers have found evidence of a galaxy merger that occurred nearly 12 billion years ago, contributing to the formation of the young Milky Way. During this early phase, the Milky Way was gathering smaller collections of stars, gas, and dark matter. This discovery enhances understanding of the galaxy's development and the processes involved in its assembly.

science.title: The Milky Way may have merged with another galaxy shortly after the Big Bang
science.summary: Astronomers have discovered evidence suggesting that the Milky Way merged with another galaxy shortly after the Big Bang. This finding contributes to understanding the galaxy's current shape and composition. Utilizing data from the Hubble Space Telescope, researchers have made significant progress in studying the Milky Way's history, despite the challenges of examining events from such an early cosmic period.

entertainment.title: Taurus Horoscope Today: August 22, 2026
entertainment.summary: Today, Taurus, focus on your direction rather than just momentum. Avoid confusing urgency with impulsive actions. It’s important to release any mental exhaustion from your recent past to gain clarity. By doing so, you can better align your actions with your goals and aspirations. Stay grounded and mindful as you navigate your path forward.

entertainment.title: Capricorn Horoscope Today: August 22, 2026
entertainment.summary: On August 22, 2026, Capricorns may experience clarity by tuning into their hearts, alleviating confusion. This shift encourages adaptability and a desire for peace over haste. As they navigate their day, they may find themselves embracing a more flexible mindset, allowing for stability in their decisions. Overall, the focus is on inner harmony and reducing stress.

entertainment.title: Aquarius Horoscope Today: August 22, 2026
entertainment.summary: Aquarius individuals may experience a significant realization about their personal growth on August 22, 2026. They might recognize traits in themselves that they previously resisted or disliked, leading to an eye-opening epiphany. This awareness can influence how they wish to shape their lives and relationships moving forward, prompting a desire for change and a more fulfilling existence.
